content.title: How to watch Real Madrid vs Bayern Munich
content.text: How Harry Kane's winning goal saw Bayern Munich edge past Real Madrid in the Champions League quarter-finalBayern Munich left Madrid with a 2-1 first-leg advantage in their quarter-finalHarry Kane celebrates scoring for Bayern Munich against Real Madrid. Getty ImagesThe match kicks off at the usual prime time slot of 9pm CEST, local time in Spain, which is 8pm BST in the UK.Across the pond, that works out as 3pm ET and 12pm (midday) PT on the east and west coast.Hello and welcome to today's Champions League coverage! Getty ImagesHello everyone and welcome to live coverage of Real Madrid vs Bayern Munich in the Champions League.Two of the biggest and most popular clubs in European football, and indeed world football, face off today in the quarter-final first leg in Spain.The Athletic will have all the build-up, predictions, team news and analysis you could ask for in the hours before kick-off.So why would you want to be anywhere else?
